LeaderboardEntry.title: Leaderboard Entry
LeaderboardEntry.description: A real-time student leaderboard ranking record representing quiz scores, mastered words, and streak.

id.description: Unique identifier of the leaderboard record

score.description: Total cumulative score points earned from quizzes

wordsMastered.description: Number of vocabulary and expressions mastered

tier.description: Achievement tier title e.g. 새싹, 꿈나무, 모험가, 마스터

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last score update

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Collection of all student leaderboard rankings ordered by score
